name: Racial Discrimination
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that God does not show partiality based on race or status, as He is the Lord over all and the Creator of every person (Deuteronomy 10:17; Proverbs 22:2). Believers are commanded to treat strangers and foreigners with love and kindness, reflecting the mercy God showed His people when they were strangers in Egypt (Leviticus 19:33-34). The unity of all humanity under one Creator calls Christians to reject any form of racial discrimination, honoring the brotherhood established by God (Malachi 2:10). Jesus' teaching to do unto others as we would have done to us (Matthew 7:12) further underscores the call to love and respect all individuals without distinction.
